{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:North American cuisines|North America]] | [[Cookbook:Southwestern cuisine|Southwestern cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Beans|Beans]] | [[Cookbook:Rice|Rice]]
==Ingredients==

* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] cooked [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* 15 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounce]] can [[Cookbook:Black Beans|black beans]], drained
* 10 ounce can [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]] and [[Cookbook:Jalapeño|green chiles]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]

==Procedure==

# In [[Cookbook:Pots and Pans|medium saucepan]], combine beans, tomatoes and green chiles mix, and cumin.
# Heat through.
# Serve over hot rice.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Ro-Tel makes canned tomatoes and green chiles.
